description: Codex throughput display plus delayed TTFT backfill; missing version caches fall back safely through PLUGIN_DATA.

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{}\n'; elif [ -f "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/collector.mjs" ]; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/collector.mjs" Stop; elif [ -f "${PLUGIN_DATA}/runtime/dispatch.mjs" ]; then node "${PLUGIN_DATA}/runtime/dispatch.mjs" collector Stop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output '{}'; exit 0 }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\collector.mjs") { node "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\collector.mjs" Stop } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$env:PLUGIN_DATA\runtime\dispatch.mjs") { node "$env:PLUGIN_DATA\runtime\dispatch.mjs" collector Stop } else { Write-Output '{}' }

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{}\n'; elif [ -f "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/backfill.mjs" ]; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/backfill.mjs" Stop; elif [ -f "${PLUGIN_DATA}/runtime/dispatch.mjs" ]; then node "${PLUGIN_DATA}/runtime/dispatch.mjs" backfill Stop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output '{}'; exit 0 }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\backfill.mjs") { node "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\backfill.mjs" Stop } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$env:PLUGIN_DATA\runtime\dispatch.mjs") { node "$env:PLUGIN_DATA\runtime\dispatch.mjs" backfill Stop } else { Write-Output '{}' }
